name: STULZ
description: Hamburg family-owned cooling manufacturer for data centres and server rooms: precision close-control air conditioning, high-density and rack-based cooling, liquid cooling, chillers, air-handling units and micro data centres, with monitoring.
notes: Describes itself as a Hamburg-based family business; no acquisition or ownership change was found. The pages avoid the phrase 'precision air conditioning' in the copy read, though the product taxonomy is close-control cooling.
